Ooredoo Algérie a décidé de prolonger la: Ooredoo Algeria has decided to extend the participation period for the 19th edition of the “Étoile des Médias” competition, an initiative dedicated to media professionals. This decision follows several requests from journalists and after validation by the selection committee. The new deadline allows a greater number of participants to submit their work.
La date limite pour le dépôt des contrib: The deadline for submitting contributions is Monday August 31, 2026. The organizers invite journalists not to miss this opportunity to showcase their talents.
